summary: Czechia is permissive for the roof rat. It uses a negative-list system: under the Animal Protection Act (Zákon 246/1992 Sb.) and Decree 451/2021 Sb., only enumerated species need a 'special-care' permit — and Rattus rattus (Czech: krysa obecná) is NOT on that list, so it's freely kept as a hobby animal. It's also absent from the EU invasive-species Union list and from Czechia's national IAS framework (Zákon 364/2021 Sb.), and not CITES-listed. So a hobbyist may keep, breed and sell/give captive-bred roof rats with no permit; only commercial-scale breeding/trade requires registering with the regional veterinary office (KVS) at least 7 days ahead. Intra-EU movement of pet rodents needs no harmonized health certificate. (Czech usefully distinguishes 'krysa' = R. rattus from 'potkan' = R. norvegicus.)

keep.why: R. rattus is not in Příloha č. 1 of Vyhláška 451/2021 Sb. (the exhaustive list of species requiring special care + a veterinary permit), so private keeping needs no permit/registration — only the general welfare duties of Zákon 246/1992 Sb. Not CITES-listed. Hobby keeping/sale from own breeding is a 'free trade' category under Czech trade law.
keep.governing_law: Zákon 246/1992 Sb.; Vyhláška 451/2021 Sb. (special-care list — R. rattus absent).

breed.why: Hobby breeding needs no permit (R. rattus outside the special-care list; no EU/national rule mandates registration of this species). Commercial/business-scale breeding must register with the regional Krajská veterinární správa (KVS) ≥7 days before starting (Zákon 166/1999 Sb. §5(2)). No species-specific prohibition or quota; Zákon 364/2021 Sb. (IAS) doesn't list R. rattus.
breed.governing_law: Zákon 166/1999 Sb. §5(2) (commercial registration); Zákon 364/2021 Sb. (IAS — R. rattus not listed).

sell_give.why: Giving away from one's own hobby breeding is unrestricted; selling from own breeding is a 'free trade' (živnost volná) needing only business notification if operated as a business. Occasional hobbyist-to-hobbyist sales don't ordinarily trigger that. No species ban/permit/quota for R. rattus; welfare conditions of Zákon 246/1992 Sb. §13 apply (e.g., no sale to under-15s without parental consent).
sell_give.governing_law: Zákon 246/1992 Sb. §13; Zákon 455/1991 Sb. (trade law, free-trade annex).

transport.why: Intra-EU non-commercial movement of pet rodents (EU Reg. 576/2013 Annex I Part B; up to 5 animals, owner-accompanied) needs no harmonized health certificate; the Czech veterinary administration (SVS) imposes no conditions provided the origin isn't under an animal-health alert. Commercial consignments may need TRACES NT notification. No IAS bar (R. rattus not on the Union list). Never release.
transport.governing_law: EU Reg. 576/2013 Annex I Part B; SVS travel guidance.

restrictions.summary: Keeping/breeding/selling captive-bred roof rats is legal in Czechia with no permit for hobbyists. Only at commercial/business scale must you register with the regional veterinary office (KVS) ≥7 days before starting. Never release a roof rat.
steps: If commercial-scale, register with the regional Krajská veterinární správa (KVS) ≥7 days ahead

inquiry_focus: (1) Objevuje se Rattus rattus (krysa obecná) v Příloze č. 1 vyhlášky č. 451/2021 Sb. jako druh vyžadující zvláštní péči, nebo je zcela mimo tento seznam pro soukromý chov a rozmnožování? (2) Pro soukromého chovatele prodávajícího mláďata z vlastního chovu krysy obecné (malé množství, nekomerční rozsah) — je vyžadována registrace/povolení u KVS, a od jaké úrovně činnosti? (3) Pro nekomerční vnitrounijní přepravu krysy obecné (do 5 zvířat, doprovázené majitelem) vyžaduje Česko nějaké doklady nad rámec nařízení (EU) 576/2013?
